THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ANCHOR REALTY, INC. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RAMIREZ, DAVID THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 632 SAN BRUNO AVENUE #6 SAN FRANCISCO, CA. $2,724.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,724.00, STAYED UNTIL NOV-16-2005, SEE SCANNED DOC. THE $2,724.00 IN THE RENT BOX OF THE JUDGMENT REPRESENTS PAST DUE RENT AND DAILY DAMAGES ALONG WITH ATTORNEY FEES AND COST. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE SET FORTH FOR PAYMENT SCHEDULE FOR CURRENT RENT DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME THAT DEFENDANT IS PAYING INSTALLMENTS OF PAST DUE RENT AND RENTAL DAMAGES. SEE PAGE TWO PARAGRAPH (B).
